web_evidence.title: Shepherds Abiding by Jan Karon
web_evidence.note: The sustained commercial sample begins with chapter One and narrates Father Tim, Lew Boyd, Hope Winchester, and Uncle Billy as he or she while moving among their private thoughts; no participating narrator frames the scenes.

web_evidence.title: Shepherds Abiding Reader's Guide
web_evidence.note: The publisher's guide describes the novel as seen through Father Tim's eyes while also following other villagers; Karon explains that she moves among character scenes, corroborating third-person focalization rather than a participating narrator.

search_log: Searched "Shepherds Abiding" "Jan Karon" excerpt and located sustained opening samples on BingeBooks and eCampus plus the publisher product page.
Searched "Shepherds Abiding" "third person", narrator, point of view, perspective, and omniscient narrator; no credible source used those labels explicitly for this title.
Searched the title with chapter-one text and exact narrative phrases; confirmed that q00180 and q00186 occur within the sustained third-person opening.
Reviewed the Penguin Random House book page and reader's guide; the product page's Read Sample control did not expose prose in the web view, while the guide provided whole-book structural context.
Reviewed Google Books selected-page metadata and its page-252 narrative snippet for interior corroboration.

Searched the title with epistolary, diary, frame narrative, alternating narrators, multiple narrators, and first-person narrator; found no evidence of constitutive documents, a first-person frame, or sustained person alternation.
person_note: The controlling narrator is nonparticipating and third person. The opening sample sustains third-person narration across several focal characters, while Goodreads event passages from later moments likewise present characters externally and sometimes report their beliefs, memories, or thoughts. First-person and second-person forms in the quote set are confined to speech, prayer, scripture, or gnomic address. The publisher's structural guide and an interior Google Books snippet corroborate continuity beyond the opening, and targeted searches found no credible evidence of an alternating or first-person section. The only limitation is that the strongest continuous prose sample is the opening, but the independent later quote evidence and whole-book guide resolve that scope limitation.
